title: Inverted Index Structure
description: Interactive p5.js MicroSim that builds a real inverted index from three short documents. Students step through tokenizing, normalizing, and index building, then click any term to see its postings list with document IDs, term frequency, and positions.
creator: Dan McCreary
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Conversational AI

educational.learningObjective: Explain how an inverted index maps terms to documents and what tokenization, normalization, and stop word removal contribute to it.
learningObjectives: Explain how an inverted index maps each term to a postings list of documents
Describe the tokenize, normalize, and build steps of an indexing pipeline
Interpret the term frequency and positions stored in a postings list
